title: BRICS Tracker Update — Sat May 16, 2026
summary: India's BRICS FM Meeting (May 14-15, New Delhi) ended without a joint communiqué after Iran FM Araghchi publicly accused fellow BRICS member UAE of direct military involvement against Iran — prompting UAE to block the joint statement. India's Jaishankar issued a Chair's Summary only, the bloc's first high-level diplomatic breakdown due to intra-member hostility. PM Modi held bilateral meetings with FM Lavrov and FM Araghchi (first India-Iran high-level contact since the Iran conflict escalated). Simultaneously, the NDB held its 11th Annual Meeting in Moscow. RBI-chaired BRICS Payment Task Force (May 12) and FinTech Working Group (May 13) virtual sessions advanced payment infrastructure ahead of the September summit. Claims and political sections updated to reflect the FM meeting's significance for BRICS cohesion; breaking status set to true.

title: BRICS Tracker Update — Sat May 9, 2026
summary: India's 2026 BRICS chairmanship advanced this week with two working group milestones. The Second BRICS Employment Working Group Meeting concluded on May 7 in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, setting labor cooperation priorities including social security, women's workforce participation, and green-economy skills development. On May 8, India hosted the First BRICS MSME Working Group Meeting virtually, focused on bridging the SME credit gap through financial inclusion and fintech-driven payment ecosystems. The claims section was updated to reflect BRICS Bridge processing $55.49B across 4,000+ transactions and BRICS Pay targeting a September 2026 launch. Maps and economic data updated ahead of the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on May 14–15.
